visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white floral dress with thin straps sits beside a grand piano against a white grid-patterned wall. She smiles broadly, waving both hands with open palms towards the camera. (2) She points upward and gestures as a brown graphic poster for a musical event appears in the upper half of the frame, featuring text and artist portraits. (3) The scene shifts to a screen recording interface overlay showing various social media interaction buttons like 'Remix' and 'Share' while she continues talking. (4) The camera angle changes to a profile view showing her sitting at the piano; she begins playing a fast-paced piece, her hands moving rapidly across the keys. (5) Sheet music is visible on the stand as she plays. (6) The woman is back in the center, speaking to the camera with a scenic overlay of a large white modern concert hall building (Weiwuying) in the background. (7) Images of a conductor and other musicians appear in circular frame overlays while she gestures with her hands. (8) Archival footage shows her performing in a formal pink gown on a dark stage with an orchestra, followed by a full-screen promotional poster with ticket information. (9) She returns to the initial setting, leaning towards the piano and waving both hands with a smile.

The creator uses a mix of personal talking-head footage, instructional content for a social media contest, and live performance snippets to build excitement and encourage ticket sales.
